scope: Exact differential-drive kinematics plus CONDITIONAL planar no-slip dynamics; no trained policy or full MOD4 balance/contact model.

parameters.source_scope: Mass: retained current nominal Isaac parameter readback. Radius/track/motor envelope: local MOD4 engineering contract. Yaw inertia and COM: older CAD extraction at root height nearest .25m; estimates, not exact current USD identification. No full balance/closed chain, tire slip, guide wheels, spring, bus power or thermal dynamics.
